# Operations: Drafting in 3D

Run with `./ise commit <operation> '<json parameters>'`, the MCP tool `ise_commit`, or `./ise run steps.json` for several at once (one undo step). 10 operations.

### `draft.array.create`

copies of an instance in a row or grid (linear:
`direction`, `spacing`, and `count2`/`direction2`/`spacing2` for a grid),
round an axis (polar: `center`, `axis`, `angle` — 360 spreads them evenly
round, less spreads them from the original to the last — and `rotate`),
or along a draft object (path: `path`, `align`). Returns the array (a
parameter set named `name`) and its copies.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | boolean |  |  |
| `angle` | number |  |  |
| `axis` | number[] |  |  |
| `center` | number[] |  |  |
| `count` | integer | yes |  |
| `count2` | integer |  |  |
| `direction` | number[] |  |  |
| `direction2` | number[] |  |  |
| `kind` | ArrayKind | yes |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `path` | StableId |  |  |
| `rotate` | boolean |  |  |
| `source` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `spacing` | number |  |  |
| `spacing2` | number |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **ArrayKind**: `"linear"` (In a row (and, with count2, a grid).), `"polar"` (Round an axis.), `"path"` (Along a draft object (line, wire, arc, B-spline…).)
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `draft.array.update`

change an array's layout or count (copies are added
or removed); `spacing`, `spacing2` and `angle` are its parameters (a
linked one follows its formula: unlink it to set it here).

### `draft.create`

a point, line, wire, rectangle, polygon, circle, arc,
ellipse, B-spline, text, label or dimension in model space.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anchors` | StableId[] |  |  |
| `center` | number[] |  |  |
| `closed` | boolean |  |  |
| `color` | string |  |  |
| `degree` | integer |  |  |
| `end` | number |  |  |
| `fit` | boolean |  |  |
| `hatch` | Hatch |  | A hatch on a closed outline; null removes it. |
| `kind` | DraftKind | yes |  |
| `layer` | StableId |  | A layer to put it in. |
| `measure` | Measure |  |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `normal` | number[] |  |  |
| `offset` | number[] |  |  |
| `on` | StableId |  | The part the object is on (its coordinates are that part's own); null: none. |
| `plane` | StableId |  | A working plane: `points` and `center` are [u, v] (or [u, v, w]) on it, and `normal` / `x_dir` default to its own. |
| `points` | number[][] |  | [x, y, z] in project coordinates, or [u, v] on `plane`. |
| `radius` | number |  |  |
| `radius2` | number |  |  |
| `sides` | integer |  |  |
| `size` | number |  |  |
| `start` | number |  |  |
| `text` | string |  |  |
| `x_dir` | number[] |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **DraftKind**: `"point"`, `"line"`, `"wire"`, `"rectangle"`, `"polygon"`, `"circle"`, `"arc"`, `"ellipse"`, `"bspline"`, `"text"`, `"label"`, `"dimension"`
- **Hatch**: `angle`?: number, `pattern`?: string, `spacing`?: number
- **Measure**: "x" \| "y" \| "z" \| "diameter" \| "aligned" \| "angle" \| "radius". What a dimension measures.
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `draft.to_sketch`

flat draft geometry (lines, wires, rectangles,
polygons, circles, arcs, ellipses, B-splines, points) as a new sketch on
their common plane, curves joined where they meet: lines, arcs and
circles as they are, ellipses and B-splines as exact cubic Béziers
(ellipses to within 0.03 %). Text, labels and dimensions are left out.
`delete: true` removes the draft objects it used.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delete` | boolean |  |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `targets` | StableId[] | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>
